MINISTRY OF CORPORATE AFFAIRS 

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi, the 31st July, 2018 

S.O. 3838(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (2) of section 1 of the Companies 

(Amendment) Act, 2017 (1 of 2018), the Central Government hereby appoints the day of 31st   July, 2018 as 

the date on which the provisions of Section 36 of the said Act shall come into force. 

[F. No. 1 /1 /2018-CL.I]
